title.purpose: The Playlists screen heading and its sidebar link. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
title.where: Sidebar section link; Playlists screen heading.

empty.purpose: Says there are no playlists yet. Mirrors crates:empty. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
empty.where: Sidebar under Playlists; Playlists screen list.

list.label.purpose: Accessible name of the list of playlists. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

trackCount_zero.purpose: How many tracks a playlist or its table holds. Mirrors crates:trackCount. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
trackCount_zero.where: Playlists screen list and the line over the table.

trackCount_one.purpose: How many tracks a playlist or its table holds. Mirrors crates:trackCount. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
trackCount_one.where: Playlists screen list and the line over the table.

trackCount_other.purpose: How many tracks a playlist or its table holds. Mirrors crates:trackCount. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
trackCount_other.where: Playlists screen list and the line over the table.

noTracks.purpose: Empty state of a playlist with no tracks. Mirrors crates:noTracks. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
noTracks.where: Playlists screen, a playlist with no tracks.

select.purpose: Asks to choose a playlist from the list. Mirrors crates:select. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

copiedFrom.purpose: Says a playlist is a one-time copy of a rekordbox playlist, and which. {{path}} is its place in rekordbox. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
copiedFrom.where: Playlists screen, under the name of a copied playlist.

new.label.purpose: Label of the box for a new playlist's name. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

new.confirm.purpose: Button that makes the playlist. Same as crates:new.confirm. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

new.cancel.purpose: Button that closes the create form. Same as crates:new.cancel. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

rename.button.purpose: Button: rename the chosen playlist. Same as crates:rename.button. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

rename.label.purpose: Label of the box for the new name. Same as crates:rename.label. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

rename.confirm.purpose: Button that renames. Same as crates:rename.confirm. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

rename.cancel.purpose: Button that closes the rename form. Same as crates:rename.cancel. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

delete.button.purpose: Button: delete the chosen playlist. Same as crates:delete.button. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

delete.title.purpose: Question asked before a playlist is deleted; {{name}} is the playlist. Mirrors crates:delete.title. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

delete.detail.purpose: Reassures that deleting a playlist keeps its tracks in the Library and can be undone. Adapts crates:delete.detail. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

delete.confirm.purpose: Button that deletes. Same as crates:delete.confirm. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

delete.cancel.purpose: Button that backs out of the delete. Same as crates:delete.cancel. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

removeTrack.button.purpose: Row button: take this track out of the playlist. Mirrors crates:removeTrack.button. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
removeTrack.button.where: Playlists screen, last column of each row.

removeTrack.buttonFor.purpose: Accessible name of the row's remove button; {{title}} is the track. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

saveAsCrate.button.purpose: Button: make a crate from the playlist's tracks (each once, order dropped). (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

saveAsCrate.label.purpose: Label of the box for the new crate's name. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

fromCrate.button.purpose: Button: start a playlist from the chosen crate, in the order its table shows now. Roadmap wording. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

fromCrate.label.purpose: Label of the box for the new playlist's name. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

fromRekordbox.button.purpose: Button: open the picker of rekordbox playlists to copy into the app. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

fromRekordbox.label.purpose: Accessible name of the picker of rekordbox playlists. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

fromRekordbox.none.purpose: Says the last rekordbox read has no playlists to copy. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

fromRekordbox.entries_one.purpose: How many entries a rekordbox playlist has (repeats and tracks outside the Library included). (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
fromRekordbox.entries_one.where: Playlists screen, rekordbox picker, beside each playlist.

fromRekordbox.entries_other.purpose: How many entries a rekordbox playlist has (repeats and tracks outside the Library included). (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
fromRekordbox.entries_other.where: Playlists screen, rekordbox picker, beside each playlist.

fromRekordbox.nameLabel.purpose: Label of the box for the copy's name (starts as the rekordbox playlist's). (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

fromRekordbox.confirm.purpose: Button that makes the app playlist from the picked rekordbox playlist. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

done.created.purpose: Line saying a playlist was made. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.created.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.renamed.purpose: Line saying a playlist was renamed. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.renamed.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.deleted.purpose: Line saying a playlist was deleted. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.deleted.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.removed.purpose: Line saying a track was taken out of the playlist; {{title}} is the track. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.removed.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.moved_one.purpose: Line saying how many tracks a drag moved to another place. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.moved_one.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.moved_other.purpose: Line saying how many tracks a drag moved to another place. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.moved_other.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.keptOrder.purpose: Line saying the playlist now has the order its fit sort showed. (PROPOSED, 4B-FU)
done.keptOrder.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.savedAsCrate.purpose: Line saying the playlist was saved as a crate. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.savedAsCrate.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.copied_one.purpose: Line saying a rekordbox playlist was copied, with how many tracks. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.copied_one.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.copied_other.purpose: Line saying a rekordbox playlist was copied, with how many tracks. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.copied_other.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list.

done.copiedLeftOut_one.purpose: Same, when {{left}} entries could not be matched to a Library track and were left out. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.copiedLeftOut_one.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list, after a copy from rekordbox.

done.copiedLeftOut_other.purpose: Same, when {{left}} entries could not be matched to a Library track and were left out. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)
done.copiedLeftOut_other.where: Playlists screen, strip above the list, after a copy from rekordbox.

addSelection.added_zero.purpose: Line over a track table after tracks were added to a playlist (drop on the sidebar, or the add dialog). Mirrors crates:addSelection.added. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

addSelection.added_one.purpose: Line over a track table after tracks were added to a playlist (drop on the sidebar, or the add dialog). Mirrors crates:addSelection.added. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

addSelection.added_other.purpose: Line over a track table after tracks were added to a playlist (drop on the sidebar, or the add dialog). Mirrors crates:addSelection.added. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1b)

error.notFound.purpose: Error: the playlist acted on was deleted meanwhile. Mirrors crates:error.notFound. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1a)
error.notFound.where: Wherever a playlist is acted on.

error.entryNotFound.purpose: Error: a drag-to-reorder dropped tracks before a track that has since left the playlist. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1a)
error.entryNotFound.where: Playlist screen, after a drag to reorder.

error.nameEmpty.purpose: Error: a playlist name is empty. Mirrors crates:error.nameEmpty. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1a)

error.nameTaken.purpose: Error: another playlist (or the Tags folder of tag playlists) has this name; {{name}} is that one's. Mirrors crates:error.nameTaken. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1a)

error.nameUnsendable.purpose: Error: the playlist name can't be written to rekordbox. Same text as crates:error.nameUnsendable. (PROPOSED, 3C-P1a)

error.rekordboxPlaylistNotFound.purpose: Error: making an app playlist from a rekordbox playlist that the newest read doesn't have (or that is empty). (PROPOSED, 3C-P1a)
error.rekordboxPlaylistNotFound.where: Making an app playlist from a rekordbox playlist.

timeline.button.purpose: Button that shows or hides the timeline over a playlist's tracks. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)
timeline.button.where: Playlists screen, over the chosen playlist.

timeline.label.purpose: Accessible name of the timeline panel. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.total.purpose: The playlist's total length (the known lengths added up). (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.unknownLengths_one.purpose: Says how many tracks have no length, so the total leaves them out. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)
timeline.unknownLengths_one.where: Timeline panel, next to the total.

timeline.unknownLengths_other.purpose: Says how many tracks have no length, so the total leaves them out. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)
timeline.unknownLengths_other.where: Timeline panel, next to the total.

timeline.untitled.purpose: Stands in for a track with no artist or title. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)
timeline.untitled.where: Timeline panel table and gap suggestions.

timeline.unknown.purpose: A value the track doesn't have (length, BPM, key, energy). Never shown as zero. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.energyTarget.purpose: A track's energy and the target shape's energy at its place. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.column.position.purpose: Column heading: the track's place in the playlist. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.column.start.purpose: Column heading: when the track starts, from the start of the playlist. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.column.track.purpose: Column heading: the track's artist and title. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.column.energy.purpose: Column heading: the track's energy (from tags or set by you) and the target. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.chart.label.purpose: Accessible name of the energy chart. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.chart.clash.purpose: Hover text of the diamond mark over a transition with a key clash, BPM jump or energy step. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.chart.unknown.purpose: Hover text of the hollow mark over a transition where a key, BPM or energy is unknown. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.target.point.purpose: Accessible name of a draggable point of the target shape; its value is the energy (1 to 10). (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.target.add.purpose: Button that adds a point to the target shape in the widest empty stretch. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.target.clear.purpose: Button that removes the whole target shape. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.target.none.purpose: Says the playlist has no target shape and how to start one. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.target.hint.purpose: How to edit the target shape. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.flag.key.clash.purpose: Mark on a transition whose keys clash. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.flag.key.unknown.purpose: Mark on a transition where one of the two tracks has no key. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.flag.bpm.clash.purpose: Mark on a transition whose tempo jumps (half and double time read as the closest); the change in BPM. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.flag.bpm.unknown.purpose: Mark on a transition where one of the two tracks has no BPM. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.flag.energy.clash.purpose: Mark on a transition whose energy jumps; the change in energy. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.flag.energy.unknown.purpose: Mark on a transition where one of the two tracks has no energy. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.fill.button.purpose: Button that lists tracks that fit the place between two tracks (or before the first, after the last). (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)
timeline.fill.button.where: Timeline panel, at every place a track could go.

timeline.fill.before.purpose: Accessible name of Fill the gap at the start of the playlist. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.fill.between.purpose: Accessible name of Fill the gap between two tracks. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.fill.after.purpose: Accessible name of Fill the gap at the end of the playlist. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.fill.title.purpose: Heading of the suggestions for one gap. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)
timeline.fill.title.where: Timeline panel, under Fill the gap.

timeline.fill.target.purpose: The target shape's energy at the gap. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.fill.none.purpose: Says no Library track has a reason to fit the gap. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.fill.list.purpose: Accessible name of the list of suggestions. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.fill.insert.purpose: Button that adds the suggested track at this place in the playlist. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

timeline.fill.insertFor.purpose: Accessible name of Insert here for one suggestion. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.keyBridge.purpose: Reason: the two neighbours' keys clash and this track's key sits between them. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.keyFits.purpose: Reason: the key fits both neighbours. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.keyFitsAfter.purpose: Reason: the key fits the track before (the gap is at the end). (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.keyFitsBefore.purpose: Reason: the key fits the track after (the gap is at the start). (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.keyFitsOnly.purpose: Reason: the track's key, when the neighbours have none. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.bpmStep.purpose: Reason: the two neighbours' tempos jump and this track's tempo sits between them. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.bpmFits.purpose: Reason: the tempo fits both neighbours. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.bpmFitsAfter.purpose: Reason: the tempo fits the track before. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.bpmFitsBefore.purpose: Reason: the tempo fits the track after. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.bpmFitsOnly.purpose: Reason: the track's tempo, when the neighbours have none. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.energyStep.purpose: Reason: the energy lies between the neighbours' energies. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.energyStepAfter.purpose: Reason: the energy follows the track before. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.energyStepBefore.purpose: Reason: the energy leads to the track after. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.energyStepOnly.purpose: Reason: the track's energy, when the neighbours have none. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

gap.energyTarget.purpose: Reason: the energy is near the target shape at this place. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

done.targetSet.purpose: Line over the screen after the target shape changes. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

done.targetCleared.purpose: Line over the screen after the target shape is cleared. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)

done.inserted.purpose: Line over the screen after Insert here adds a suggested track. (PROPOSED, 3C-P2b)
